The requester authorizes independent randomized complex scenes to test updated fashion keywords in generated pixels using the attached portrait. My artistic choice is a calm exhibition installation moment inside a tram depot, with face, action, skirt outline and hosiery material relationships simultaneously legible. The specific scene and wardrobe are agent choices for testing, not a requester definition.

A quiet cinematic fashion editorial at blue hour after rain, inside an art deco tram depot being prepared for a small heritage exhibition. A clearly adult woman, around twenty-nine, brings a framed route-map print upright on a padded waist-high worktable: her left hand grips its upper corner, her right hand holds the lower side, and its bottom edge remains on the padded table as the top edge becomes horizontal. The table and frame sit beside her rather than across her legs. Both feet rest flat on the dry aisle floor, knees softly extended, with a slight torso turn toward the worktable and her face turned toward the camera. Use the supplied portrait as guidance for visible face and hair appearance: short dark bob, fine separated fringe, softly rounded facial contours, and readable dark eyes. Her calm focused expression belongs to this working moment. She wears a fully buttoned pale ivory collared blouse tucked into a warm charcoal tailored mini skirt, the skirt's continuous exterior hem ending high on her thighs with a coherent short skirt silhouette. Black sheer thigh-high hosiery ends above each knee; an uninterrupted band of bare thigh skin lies between the skirt hem and each hosiery top. Fine translucent knit reveals underlying skin tone through the hosiery, while narrow soft highlights track the textile surface along the shins. Simple dark low-heeled shoes anchor her stance. Photograph from a front three-quarter full-body view including her head, hands, knees and both shoes, using natural proportions and a readable face. Cool skylight mixes with an amber work lamp; skin bands, hosiery tops, transparent weave and textile sheen remain individually legible. A tram body and repeating arched windows recede behind her; damp reflections remain outside the open depot doorway.
